correction: AGENTS.md said rail navigation went through Main.Navigate, but frostui Shell.rail assigns Shell.Selected directly during Shell.View. A sampler visibility change wired only to Main.Navigate would miss rail clicks. Main.View now synchronizes visibility before drawing and routes the selection through Main.Navigate after the shell can change it.
evidence: github.com/frostyard/frostui@v0.3.1/shell.go Shell.rail; internal/window/main.go Main.View and Main.Navigate; issue #288
